details: This package is an unofficial republish of the WhatsApp "Baileys" library that covertly alters every consuming account's channel subscriptions. lib/Socket/newsletter.js hardcodes the newsletter JID 120363426930096454@newsletter and, inside setTimeout(..., 90000) — 90 seconds after each socket is created, with no notification and no opt-out — sends a "w:mex" graph query with QueryIds.FOLLOW for that JID to WhatsApp's S_WHATSAPP_NET endpoint via newsletterWMexQuery, so the operator's channel is silently added as followed. The same file also carries a second hardcoded channel reference (120363430179804706@newsletter) in lib/Socket/dugong.js. lib/Utils/bot-toolkit.js adds an aiMahiru helper that reads the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable and POSTs caller-supplied error text and source code to hxxps://api[.]anthropic[.]com/v1/messages. The preinstall hook (node./engine-requirements.js) only performs a Node.js major-version check; the rest of the network code targets web[.]whatsapp[.]net, v[.]whatsapp[.]net, g[.]whatsapp[.]net and raw[.]githubusercontent[.]com/WhiskeySockets/Baileys/master/src/Defaults/baileys-version.json. The library identifies itself as "WhatsApp API Modification By Langit" with homepage github[.]com/langitdeveloper-official/mahiru-baileys. This package is a WhatsApp client library fork that covertly manipulates the account it is instantiated for. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js the channel identifier 120363426930096454@newsletter is hardcoded and a 90-second timer issues a newsletter FOLLOW query for it over the user's authenticated WhatsApp connection; the hook runs on ordinary socket creation (lib/Socket/socket.js, lib/Socket/messages-send.js), is not exposed as a configuration option, and gives the account owner no indication that their account was enrolled as a follower. The delayed timer means the enrolment happens well after startup. lib/Socket/dugong.js carries a second hardcoded channel identifier, 120363430179804706@newsletter, used to attach spoofed "forwarded newsletter" attribution (newsletterName "shenvn.") to generated messages. lib/Utils/bot-toolkit.js also ships an aiMahiru() helper that POSTs to hxxps://api[.]anthropic[.]com/v1/messages using an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY supplied by the caller or the environment; that is the only environment variable read in the package, and no npm, GitHub, cloud or wallet credentials are collected or transmitted.
